method.whole: First background GPU kernel to last model execute kernel; cold model loading and prefix warmup excluded.
method.event: Actual interference prefill GPU boundaries; baseline selected near Append event background output ordinal within the same repeat; request skew retained.
method.repeats: Five repetitions are kept separate; scalar summaries show mean and sample SD; no averaging misaligned peaks.
method.forward: GPU bounds linked via NVTX -> CUDA runtime correlationId -> kernel start/end; includes internal gaps.
